reasons.plausibility: Using a WC interlayer to improve interfacial heat conduction seems scientifically sound, albeit with some minor open questions about long-term irradiation effects.
reasons.testability: They propose a clear and feasible experiment with a control group and measurable outcomes (thermal conductivity, strength, irradiation damage) and a clear pass/fail criterion.
reasons.usefulness: It directly tackles a key challenge—enhancing thermal conductivity without compromising mechanical and irradiation properties—in a way that is practical and relevant to W–Cu applications.
